motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Half a peg of lemonade, half a peg of juniper berries, half a peg of minted liqueur... and topped off with mystery flavored ice cubes; it's a strange recipe, isn't it? It's my first time mixing anything and I wasn't even able to open the shaker, so this might taste terrible. Even so, would you mind trying out this creation of mine, the “Miss Haunted House”?
